problems.symptom: Users could receive 'Не удалось загрузить сайт' before the real page rendered.
problems.root_cause: Production served a browser bootstrap that fetched p0.bin..p4.bin and reconstructed/decompressed the real HTML client-side instead of serving the verified self-contained page directly.
problems.resolution: Production deployment dpl_2k1x8VbTGQtisfTptmeUzfafJane builds and serves the project as direct self-contained HTML. Release/live guards forbid the old loader markers.
problems.verification: Vercel build log: 115467-byte direct self-contained PASS; public kyokushin-nn.vercel.app returned HTTP 200 with x-kyokushin-build=self-contained and real UI markers.

problems.symptom: A merged, green source change does not yet prove unattended publication of that exact commit to the public Vercel domain.
problems.root_cause: The current Vercel project is not Git-linked, and unattended GitHub Actions deployment requires a usable VERCEL_TOKEN secret.
problems.mitigation: Source CI fails closed for production deployment without credentials; authenticated Vercel OAuth can recover production directly; release-aware smoke prevents stale production from being reported as current.
problems.completion_gate: A push to project/kyokushin-nn completes verify -> Vercel production deploy -> exact-release public smoke without manual intervention.

problems.symptom: Headless Chromium screenshot QA hangs in the current container.
problems.root_cause: Current evidence points to the execution container's D-Bus/zygote environment rather than a website runtime defect.
problems.completion_gate: Run responsive visual/runtime QA on a normal browser-capable runner against an exact release and preserve the resulting evidence.
